experiment: Phase 5b FQE-based offline validation of compare_policies.py

cql_minus_bc_fqe_bootstrap.caveat: This bootstrap resamples across only len(values) paired points (typically 3 training seeds) -- treat the resulting CI as illustrative of seed variability, not a substitute for the much larger per-episode bootstrap in compare_policies.py.

how_to_cross_check: Load the corresponding compare_policies.py output (reports/<run>/policy_comparison.json) and compare cql_minus_bc_paired_bootstrap.observed_difference / ci_lower / ci_upper there against cql_minus_bc_fqe_bootstrap above. FQE and direct rollout measure value via completely different mechanisms (offline critic fit vs exact simulator rollout) so exact numeric agreement is not expected -- sign agreement and non-overlapping conclusions (both exclude zero in the same direction, or both contain zero) is the meaningful check.
api_verification_caveat: This script's d3rlpy.ope.DiscreteFQEConfig usage was NOT verified against a live d3rlpy install when written -- see module docstring 'API VERIFICATION STATUS'. If numbers here look implausible (e.g. far outside the range of compare_policies.py's return_mean values), suspect the FQE call shape before suspecting the underlying policies.
